README frame command (--ticks 700 --inputs 0:enter,1:shoot --frame frame.png --size 800x480) wrote frame.png; PNG header 800x480. Same for 4 other frames.
Fresh title texts: [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], no Continue; 0:enter -> tick 1 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10.

Settings: Left x12 took volume 8->0 and stayed at 0; Right went 8->10 and stayed at 10; language en->es->fr (stops at fr) and back to en (stops); difficulty default normal, left to easy (stops), right to hard (stops).

es: title Mejor/Empezar/Ajustes/Salir, settings Ajustes/Volumen/Idioma/Dificultad/Volver, play Puntos/Monedas/Oleada 1 de 8/Puerta, shop Tienda/Manos rapidas/Virotes pesados/Albanil/Siguiente oleada, paused Pausa/Reanudar/Titulo, won La puerta resiste - ganaste. fr: same screens incl. lost (La porte est tombee - defaite) and won all in French. Only the game name stays English (key name 'Enter' kept in Spanish 'Enter: titulo').
Run 1 with --settings P set volume 5, fr, hard; run 2 with P started with volume 5, fr, hard (French title). A fresh folder started en, 8, normal.
Holding up: guard_y 6 at tick 1 -> 7 at tick 11 (6 units/s), reached 12 and stayed 12; holding down reached 0 and stayed 0.
Held shoot: new bolts at ticks 2, 26, 50, 74 (every 24); bolt x grows 0.2333/tick (14/s); a bolt at 19.03 at tick 74 was gone by tick 85.
Seed 1 wave 1: walkers enter at x=20 at ticks 1, 91, 181, 271, 361 in lanes 4,10,6,2,6, health 2, x drops 0.025/tick (1.5/s); 5 in all.
Guard at y=4 shooting: lane-4 walker health 2 -> 1 at first hit (bolt gone), destroyed at second: score 0->10, coins 0->1. Bolts at y=4 flew past walkers at y=10 and y=6 untouched.

No shooting: walker at x=0.025 tick 800, gone after, gate 10->5 after 5 walkers, score 0, coins 0. Gate 0 in wave 2 -> screen lost, texts [The gate has fallen - you lost, Score: 0, Best: ..., Enter: title].
Difficulty easy set and kept -> Start gives gate_health 14; hard -> gate_health 7 (texts Porte : 7).

After wave 1 cleared: screen shop, texts [Shop, Coins: 5, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands 0/2 - 5 coins, Heavy bolts 0/1 - 12 coins, Mason - 4 coins (gate 10), Next wave]; leftover bolt stayed at x=4.7996 across ticks 680-700.
Shop coins 40: Quick -> 35, quick 1; again -> 25, quick 2; third Enter -> unchanged. Quick 1 bolts 18 ticks apart (4.1994 units), quick 2 bolts 12 ticks apart (2.7996 units).
Heavy bought (12 coins): wave-2 walker went from health 2 to destroyed by one bolt at tick 115 (+10, +1 coin). Second Heavy Enter with 13 coins: coins and heavy unchanged.

Normal gate 4 coins 13: Mason -> 7/9 coins, -> 10/5 coins, at 10 Enter -> unchanged. Hard-run save gate 5 coins 8 (setting easy): Mason -> 7 (cap 7)/4 coins, again unchanged. Gate 5 with 0 coins: Enter unchanged.
Next wave Enter at tick 12 -> play at 13, first walker x=20 at tick 73 (60 later); HUD Wave 2 of 8 (Oleada 2 de 8, Vague 2 sur 8); wave 2 gave 7 kills (+70) before the shop.
Wave 3: walkers enter every 72 ticks (89..449, 6), then runners at 521, 593, 665, 737 (4) with health 1, x drops 0.05/tick (3/s); runner kills gave +15 and +1 coin.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then 1 brute (health 6); unshot it walked ~1/s and took gate 6 -> 3; shot with heavy bolts it went 6->4->destroyed, score +40, coins +3.
modules/work/waves.txt has one line per wave (walkers runners brutes seconds), read by lib.rs via include_str; README section 'Changing a wave' explains it.
Scripted full run from Start (seed 1) cleared 8 waves: screen won at tick 7270, score 1480 = 1280 enemy points (score 1240 + last brute 40) + 20*10 gate; Enter -> title.
Escape at tick 100 -> paused, enemies frozen at 17.575/19.825 to tick 159; Escape (Resume) -> play continued from 17.55. Title from pause -> title screen.
saved false during wave 1, true at shop (tick 680); next run with same folder: texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit].
Saved after buying Quick (wave 1, score 50, coins 0, quick 1): Continue opened shop with wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1 (10-coin price); Next wave played wave 2 with 18-tick cadence.

Start with a save -> saved false, kept.save 0, no Continue next run. Won and lost runs ended with saved false. Title from pause in wave 2 left kept.save = last shop (wave 1, score 50) and Continue shown.
Won run 1480: won screen Best: 1,480, title and later run show Best: 1,480. Then a lost run with score 0: lost screen Best: 1,480, title still Best: 1,480.

Two runs seed 7 from identical copies of a saved folder, 700 ticks with --at 200,400,600: outputs byte-identical, kept files identical. Wave 1 lanes: seed 1 [4,10,6,2,6], seed 2 [10,10,6,10,8], seed 3 [2,4,6,4,2].

play.png (wave 8): brown gate on left, blue guard at y=4, green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brute at x~19.8 y=8, white bolts on lane 4, all at the state's positions (40 px/unit); HUD Score 565, Coins 8, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 13.
title_es.png: Empezar/Ajustes/Salir with Ajustes outlined (menu_index 1); settings_fr.png: Reglages menu with Difficulte outlined (index 2); shop.png: Quick hands outlined, entries with prices.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json hold every string; screens reference @keys; README 'Adding a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate.

README has How to play, kept data (settings.json in --settings folder: volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save), and the headless and frame commands, which ran as written (with a real folder for --settings).

defects: At tick 0 the state is not ready: the title shows the unresolved text 'Best: {work.best}' and no Continue even when a save exists, so Down at tick 0 lands on Settings instead of Continue.
Positions are rounded to 4 decimals every tick, so movement drifts: a brute goes about 1.002 units/s (x 18.4469 where 18.45 is expected), and bolts a little under 14/s.
Bolts still in flight when a wave ends stay frozen through the shop and carry on into the next wave in an unbroken run.
Volume changes nothing that can be heard: no sounds are attached, as the README admits.
